quality.label: Audio quality ceiling
quality.description: auto uses the best quality the account allows; FLAC and Dolby require a premium membership.

min_duration.label: Minimum duration (seconds)
min_duration.description: Filters out short clips, previews and teasers.

max_duration.label: Maximum duration (seconds)
max_duration.description: Filters out hour-long loops, live replays and courses.

search_limit.label: Search result limit
search_limit.description: Maximum number of tracks returned per search.

verify_stream_url.label: Probe the CDN before playback
verify_stream_url.description: Checks the preferred CDN with a 1 KB range request and falls back to a backup host when it fails.

sessdata_manual.label: Manual SESSDATA cookie
sessdata_manual.description: Fallback when QR login is unavailable. Read-only favorites also need the DedeUserID cookie.

sessdata.label: SESSDATA cookie
sessdata.description: Copy the SESSDATA cookie value from your browser's developer tools.

dedeuserid.label: DedeUserID cookie
dedeuserid.description: Needed to read your favorite folders; optional otherwise.

sessdata_qr_unavailable.label: SESSDATA cookie
sessdata_qr_unavailable.description: QR code login is unavailable because the optional segno package is not installed. Install it with `pip install {0}` (inside the Music Assistant environment) and run setup again, or paste a SESSDATA cookie below.

choose.title: Choose how to sign in
choose.description: QR login can read your favorite folders; you can also continue anonymously and connect an account later.

manual.title: Paste your cookies
manual.description: Copy the SESSDATA and DedeUserID cookies from your browser's developer tools.

scan_qr.title: Scan the QR code
scan_qr.description: Scan the QR code with the Bilibili app and confirm the login.

expired.title: The QR code expired
expired.description: Request a new QR code and scan it again.

manifest.description: Bilibili video audio as a music source (unofficial, read-only).
